about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Holy Family of Jesus, Mary, and Joseph” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord Jesus, Who refreshest us with heavenly sacraments, grant that we may continually imitate the examples of Thy Holy Family, and that at the hour of our death, when the glorious Virgin Thy Mother and blessed Joseph come to meet us, we may through Thee merit to be received into the everlasting tabernacles. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
